FIBIU-15.name: Structured methodological assumptions
FIBIU-15.documented_human_judgement_contract: documented_human_judgement remains a LEGITIMATE basis and must NOT require an invented or fabricated external source. No fictitious external source is demanded; the nature and limits of the basis must be explicit. provenance_reference is NOT NULL only when basis_type='evidence_or_external_source' (FIBDB-047).
FIBIU-15.versioning_contract: A material modification creates a NEW VERSION. Where a material assumption affects the inputs of an APPROVED run, a NEW RUN is required.
FIBIU-15.approval_contract: NO separate per-assumption approval is required by default. Material assumptions enter the run snapshot and the independent review package.
FIBIU-15.no_auto_conversion: Existing legacy free text — impact_narratives.assumptions (db/schema.ts:208) and theory_of_change_links.assumption (db/schema.ts:1238) — is NEVER auto-converted into an authoritative structured assumption (NPDD-03). Human action remains required. The UI may OPTIONALLY seed creation by displaying the old free text for a person to re-author; display is not conversion.
FIBIU-15.fail_closed: An unresolved material assumption blocks approval.
FIBIU-15.exit_gate: An unresolved material assumption blocks approval.

FIBIU-14.name: Counterfactual assessment
FIBIU-14.baseline_contract: A baseline is a RELEVANT SOURCE WHEN IT EXISTS, explicitly NOT EQUIVALENT to the counterfactual and NOT numerically mandatory. indicators.baseline_value is NOT automatically a counterfactual and never auto-converts (NPDD-03); it is read-only input to this unit. Absent a baseline, deadweight may rest on comparisons, historical trends, benchmarks, statistics, literature, stakeholder evidence, or documented assumptions.
FIBIU-14.deadweight_support_contract: supported vs unknown_or_insufficient must be EXPLICITLY DISTINGUISHED. Every deadweight, INCLUDING 0, needs justification and an identifiable counterfactual basis. A zero deadweight value is legitimate ONLY with an identifiable basis and rationale. unknown_or_insufficient is usable in preliminary work and FAILS CLOSED for approval/lock, surfacing as DEADWEIGHT_BASIS_INSUFFICIENT.
FIBIU-14.exit_gate: Supported vs unknown deadweight are distinguished and the latter blocks.

FIBIU-16.name: Causal chain sufficiency gate
FIBIU-16.no_new_db_object: The existing ToC graph remains the storage representation. No new table.
FIBIU-16.measured_gap: getSroiCalculationReadiness (lib/pipeline/sroi-calculation.ts:1046) consults NEITHER theory_of_change_nodes NOR theory_of_change_links today, and an outcome can be monetized with zero nodes. Causal-chain sufficiency must become an ELIGIBILITY CONDITION for SROI run approval/readiness.
FIBIU-16.graph_status: The native graph stays RECOMMENDED, NOT MANDATORY.
FIBIU-16.preserved_prohibition: activity → outcome shortcuts remain forbidden when the required intermediate causal structure is absent. activity → output → outcome holds. Already correctly enforced at lib/pipeline/theory-of-change.ts:26-28,158-160 and declared satisfied as-is by FIB §12 — the successor mission must preserve it as a NON-REGRESSION, not reimplement it.
FIBIU-16.accepted_representations: The native ToC graph, OR an external causal model (theory of change, logframe, results chain) SUFFICIENTLY MAPPED into the governed representation.
FIBIU-16.document_upload_insufficient: Merely uploading a document, without mapping, does NOT satisfy causal sufficiency.
FIBIU-16.material_shortcut_contract: A material causal shortcut must be represented through the FIBIU-15 structured assumption mechanism (FIBC-019), NEVER as a direct link and never as a bypass of the gate.
FIBIU-16.ordering_constraint: Do NOT implement FIBIU-16 before FIBIU-15. See p1a_synchronization.fibiu_16_is_not_parallelizable_before_fibiu_15.
FIBIU-16.exit_gate: A monetized outcome without a sufficient causal chain is ineligible.
